pos.personaBrief: Inter 2020/21 dropped from 61% possession to 45% during the winning run and was dangerous on the break (Lukaku most shots on the break, 48 second-half goals), though it could also play a possession game.

pro.personaBrief: Inter built out from the back through Brozovic/Eriksen and De Vrij/Bastoni, but with Lukaku as a target and swift wing-back counters; verticality and line-breaking passes were valued.

est.personaBrief: A rehearsed 3-5-2 with fixed roles and wing-backs staying wide, while Lukaku dropped to link play and the attack was spread rather than rondo-like.

lar.personaBrief: Wing-backs (Young, Moses, Hakimi, Perisic) supplied width and crosses with emphasis on wing-play, and no traditional wingers were used; central midfield stayed crowded.

blo.personaBrief: Inter pressed with front two and attacking midfielders, flank pressing around the wing-back, but often defended in a 5-3-2 mid block and soaked up pressure.

mar.personaBrief: Conte's teams are described as man-oriented with chain-reaction marking and a centre-back stepping out on the ball carrier; dedicated markers and clear individual responsibility fit.

pla.personaBrief: Conte imposed his 3-5-2 and cleared out players who did not fit (Icardi, Perisic, Nainggolan), staying with the same system against any opponent, with limited sacrifice of the model.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic result-first: shifted to a more pragmatic approach in the winning run, Scudetto won, sources note solidity, and he stated balance matters first.

sis.personaBrief: Conte demands tactical duties from all, drilled system, and ruthless with stars who did not fit (Icardi); stars like Lukaku have defined roles.

jog.personaBrief: Physical wing-backs and Lukaku as strong target, high running demands; yet Brozovic and Eriksen were valued for passing in midfield.

bas.personaBrief: Inter squad built with older experienced title winners and Premier League veterans (Young, Moses, Lukaku, Eriksen) per City AM, with signings preferred over the academy.

lid.personaBrief: Conte is the boss with frank talk and ruthless clear-outs of stars who did not align; same rules for all and discipline over a relaxed atmosphere.
